reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code, because that is the only kind of proof I care about. I would scan it before buying and try one box of the bisglycinate, since citrate wrecks my stomach and the complex has citrate in it.
objection: Most supplements are marketing. A QR code can still open a nice-looking PDF, and I have no way to know the lab report is really for the box in my hand.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report was vague, not tied to a batch number, or from a lab I could not look up, I would skip it.
